approvers: Owner/partner, plus the main contractor or developer if they would pay for it
reason: I spend about 500 euro a year on glass protection, which is roughly 40 m2, so a 100 m2 minimum is more than I use in a year. At 19 euro all-in it costs more than the film and tape my lads put up at 12, and I would not take a first job on a new coating with no local reference.
objection: A peelable coating on coated glass and anodised frames in full July sun. If it bakes on or leaves a mark, it is my name on the frames, and a 2,500 euro cap does not cover a block of glazing.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and sheet with tape, applied and removed by my own people.
would_change_my_mind: A written compatibility confirmation from the coating maker for my exact glass coating and frame finish, plus a test panel left in summer sun and removed cleanly, at a price near what I pay now.
